method.arms: Narrowing arm uses order 10 log F1 bandwidth. The two-order arm retains frames with F1 and F2 tracking agreement within 120 Hz and F1 bandwidth agreement within 100 Hz. It takes the median of the positive drops in log F1 bandwidth, log F1 and log F1/F2. Trackers are correlated and the two-order agreement measures numerical stability only.
method.gate: For optional follow-up, add at least two useful locations across at least two generators in the three-generator -5 dB replication, at most one additional ordinary group and no new room-only flag over incumbent. Also locate at least two useful edits at -5 dB and two at -10 dB on the additional paired-source transfer without more than one ordinary group flagged at either level. Useful means 0.30 temporal IoU and at least half the known edit covered.
method.input: One six-second mono 16 kHz PCM16 upload. No isolated source, reference copy, edit range, speech label, or noise level enters the formant measurement.
method.point: For each candidate arm use the maximum assessed ordinary or isolated-background score on the primary development bank across dry, +5, 0 and -5 dB. Flag strictly above this frozen point. Never tune on replication or transfer. On matched primary and replication bytes, retain the prior frozen short response and exact range.
method.spans: Measure 600 ms spans on a 60 ms source-clock grid. Each comparison flank uses 360 ms, separated by a 45 ms guard. Require at least six tracked frames in each flank and ten inside. Each descriptor takes the smaller positive decrease against either flank. Select the largest response with earlier time resolving ties.
method.tracking: Resample by 2/3, apply 50 Hz preemphasis, and use a 30 ms Hann window on 15 ms source ticks. Retain the two lowest distinct LPC resonances within 200–1200 Hz and 500–3000 Hz, separated by at least 200 Hz with bandwidths between 20 and 900 Hz. Require at least 0.40 periodic autocorrelation between 70 and 400 Hz on the same native original frame. Compare order 10 to order 12 as a check on tracker dependence.
